dataSource.title: Data Sources
dataSource.description: Population figures, land area, and elevation are retrieved live from Wikidata (via the official Wikidata API), which in turn references the Philippine Statistics Authority census data. The description is provided by the Wikipedia REST API. The number of barangays is from the city directory.
